    Local simple connectivity without long morphisms #

    If P has no long morphisms, nonzero paths of the cover have length at most one (length_le_one_of_noLong), so every weight on the cover is a cocycle, hence a coboundary, and the cover is locally simply connected (coverLocalSC_of_not_hasLong).
